column6: The record has two feeders: CS2_OP_LOOT_ADD (the game's own, CS2 script lanes only) and App_LootNotifyKill (::lootkill, every lane). On the 2004 lane the cheat is the ONLY writer, so a latch reading 'the record has taken something, stop inferring' turned one ::lootkill into a permanent, silent switch-off of that lane's only account of a real kill. Measured: seed one ::lootkill, then kill an Imp -- strip 126px, one band, still 'Goblin'. Documented in a comment, asserted nowhere. The latch (record_kept) is deleted; the question is per source now.

LootStore numbers its sources from 1 (rs_loot_store.c: store->next_source_id = 1) and the bands the plugin invents were numbered from 1 too -- safe only while the two accounts could never be on the page together. Merging them made a recorded Goblin and an inferred Imp share id 1, and the id is what a click, a band menu and the detail block all key on: pressing the Imp band opened the GOBLIN's detail, 5,000 gp of coins under the word 'Imp'.
